title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Acceptance Guide: Item Types and Weight Limits
content:
Each Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery service level delivers a defined set of item types and handles single items up to a defined weight in pounds. The tables below give, for every level, the item types it delivers and the heaviest single item it handles.

## Item types served

| Item type | Curbside Delivery | Threshold Delivery | Room of Choice Delivery | White Glove Delivery | White Glove Delivery with Assembly | Premier White Glove with Haul-Away |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Boxed furniture | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Rugs | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Mattresses | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Assembled furniture | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Upholstery | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Case goods | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ready-to-assemble furniture | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |

## Heaviest single item handled

| Service level | Heaviest single item |
|---|---|
| Curbside Delivery | 150 lbs |
| Threshold Delivery | 300 lbs |
| Room of Choice Delivery | 300 lbs |
| White Glove Delivery | 400 lbs |
| White Glove Delivery with Assembly | 400 lbs |
| Premier White Glove with Haul-Away | 400 lbs |

The weight limit is a whole number of pounds and applies to each single item: an item weighing exactly the limit is within it, and an item one pound over is not.

## Acceptance points (hypothetical items)

- A rug of 40 lbs: served by Curbside Delivery, Threshold Delivery and Room of Choice Delivery; rugs are not among the item types of the three White Glove levels.
- A mattress of 120 lbs: not served by Curbside Delivery, which does not deliver mattresses; served by every other level.
- A boxed bookcase of 160 lbs: boxed furniture is served by Curbside Delivery, but 160 lbs exceeds its 150 lbs limit; Threshold Delivery and Room of Choice Delivery serve it within their 300 lbs limit.
- An upholstered sofa of 300 lbs: upholstery is served only by the three White Glove levels, each handling up to 400 lbs.
- A ready-to-assemble wardrobe: served only by White Glove Delivery with Assembly and Premier White Glove with Haul-Away.
